name: Ana Luiza Rios
bio: Ana Luiza Rios (Manaus, February 19, 1987) is a Brazilian actress, acting coach, researcher, playwright, director, and teacher.

credits.title: The Riverbank
credits.overview: Izaquiel works as a cleaner in Recife, a Brazilian city intertwined with rivers and mangroves. At night, he dangerously ventures out in search of secret encounters in the mangrove forest. His world shifts when he crosses paths with Jeremias, an intriguing and magnetic fisherman.

credits.title: Resumo da Ópera
credits.overview: Guided by a messiah, cosmonauts take over a planet, transforming its original inhabitants into workers in their work: the construction of a nation. But Ning, a collective consciousness of revolt, emerges, bringing the imminence of a general strike.

credits.title: Caustic
credits.overview: Mother and daughter discover a miraculous cure for their illness, but the price to pay involves sinister human sacrifices...

credits.title: Heavier Is the Sky
credits.overview: After taking in an abandoned child, Teresa meets Antônio and the two begin a journey on the roads. The common past, for them, is the memories of a city submerged at the bottom of a dam. Life is a dream, but the future is uncertainty.

credits.title: On The Edge
credits.overview: Niara, a police officer about to retire, faces the dichotomies of a corrupt security system alongside the broken human relations around her.
